title: Rare-earth and platinum-group metals in AI-predicted crystals: an audit of the GNoME dataset (code and results)
description: Code and result tables for an audit of Google DeepMind's GNoME dataset of AI-predicted crystals. It tests whether these materials contain critical, supply-risky elements (rare earths, platinum-group metals) more often than known materials, where the excess comes from, and whether it reaches application shortlists. Version 1.1.0 adds the checks requested in revision (notebook Level 5, result files R1 to R8). Runs in Google Colab using only public data.
